import mailbox, smtplib, os, time
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
subject = "Nonmember announcement " + os.urandom(3).hex()
msg = MIMEText("hello from a non-subscriber")
msg["Subject"] = subject
msg["From"] = "tester@local.edu"
msg["To"] = "reading-group@local.edu"
with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as s:
    s.send_message(msg)
print("sent:", subject)
# find any subscriber mailbox that has it
deadline = time.time() + 60
while time.time() < deadline:
    hits = []
    for p in __import__("glob").glob("/var/mail/v*"):
        for m in mailbox.mbox(p):
            if m.get("Subject","") == subject:
                hits.append(p)
    if hits:
        print("delivered to:", hits); break
    time.sleep(2)
else:
    print("NOT DELIVERED")
EOF
